pr_title: [3.x] Fix duplicated edges in convex hull generator
pr_body:
All edges where accumulated from all faces, which ended up with double the amount in the final mesh data leading to performance issues in godot physics.

Fix #51909 (regression from #48533)
CC @mortarroad if you would like to review

If this fix is ok I'll make a PR on master tomorrow.
pr_comments: Looks fine to me, I'd just add a couple of comments to explain what is going on in the source because it isn't immediately clear.

Ah, you're of course right. Since this is a half edge data structure, there's a *reverse* edge for every edge.

Rather than going through a set, you can simply pick one of the two as the canonical edge. (E.g. the one where `source_vertex < target_vertex`, which will only be true for one of them.)
I made a PR with my approach: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/52059

issue_context.title: Performance issue in GodotPhysics
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

3.4-beta4

### System information

OS: ubuntu 18.04

### Issue description

There is a performance issue in GodotPhysics that seems doesn't exist in v3.3.2-stable. Bullet is OK in both versions.

Godot v3.3.2-stable:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5120436/130202793-30236392-5f72-4b3e-8e55-d08129d7de41.mp4

Godot v3.4-beta4:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5120436/130203150-b64ebdd4-054a-4256-a338-609364c62b35.mp4

Bullet:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5120436/130203774-4a44fa0e-8c6e-4053-b067-8f655aa2eb1b.mp4


### Steps to reproduce

Run the attached project.
If textures doesn't show, select QodotMap node, select "addons/qodot/example_scenes/1-interactivity/1-brush-entities/1-brush-entities.map" in Map File property and press "Full Build" button.

[GodotPhysicsIssue.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/7020265/GodotPhysicsIssue.zip)
